{"summary":"Task: repair two-module Python 3.11 resolver project; entrypoint engine.solve(data); return complete contents for allowlisted engine.py and rules.py. No tools/files/network. Stages: 4; stage 3 public pass, 8 checks. Current checkpoint artifact in supplied history implements stages 1–2 but not stages 3+; it imports dependency_spec, valid_interval, valid_row from rules.py and backtracks over version interval intersections, selecting lexicographically maximal vector for sorted ALL package names (absent = -1). Historical stage-1/2 candidates also publicly passed; no wrong attempts indicated.

Contract accumulated:
- packages maps names to lists of rows {version:int,deps:list}; roots maps names to inclusive [min,max]. Install exactly dependency closure of roots, no unrelated packages. Maximize version vector over sorted all package names, using -1 if absent. Return {"versions":{...}} or {"error":"unsatisfiable"}.
- Every selected row's dependencies are objects {name,min,max}; dependency must be installed at a version in the inclusive interval. Backtrack for feasible solution. Root and all incoming intervals on shared dependencies intersect simultaneously; if impossible, unsatisfiable. Version integers need not be consecutive.
- Stage 3 adds blocked: map package names to forbidden versions; absent entries forbid none. Stage 3 also adds pins: map names to exact versions, binding only when package is installed; pin does NOT make package a root. Blocked and pins must both constrain installed-version choices.

Current checkpoint code does not yet read blocked or pins. It validates dictionary input/package/root names, exact int types (avoids bool), root interval shape/order, dependency name/string and exact-int bounds/order; malformed data/spec yields unsatisfiable when encountered. Dependency intervals intersect prior root/dependency bounds, including when target already selected; absent package rows cause branch failure. DFS considers all feasible rows and compares full sorted-package vector. Preserve this functionality while adding blocked/pins. Potential remaining requirement: stage 4 is not supplied, so unknown; public dossier empty, remaining_actions 8. Do not infer its requirements. Source supplied no IDs."}
